'''Carl Johnson's Father''' is a character mentioned in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

==History==
===Background===
Not much is known about him other than the fact that he is the father of [[Carl Johnson]], the [[Protagonist|protagonist]] of ''GTA San Andreas'', and presumably the father of [[Sweet Johnson|Sweet]], [[Kendl Johnson|Kendl]] and [[Brian Johnson|Brian]].

He is mentioned by Carl and his childhood barber [[Old Reece]]; when Carl goes to get a haircut at [[Reece's Hair & Facial Studio]], Old Reece will sometimes tell him that his father used to get a cut just like him, however he has been known to contradict this, sometimes also saying "''yo Moms used to choose all your styles''".

During [[The Introduction]], in the [[Red Light District]] in [[Portland]], [[Liberty City (3D Universe)|Liberty City]], when CJ steals a [[Washington|car]], he phones [[Joey Leone]] and tells him that he never knew his father.
